notes.title: Summer Picnic Sale!!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8561388/69a368c6078f9ab4ff050793f48995e4fd2c6e49.jpg[/img]
Princess Kaguya: Legend of the Moon Warrior is currently [b]65%[/b] off for the Steam Summer Picnic Sale until July 4th. 
If you haven’t had a chance to get your copy yet now’s your chance!

Actually all of Zoo’s games are on sale this weekend for up to [b]90%[/b] off.
Check out the full list of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/search/?publisher=Zoo%20Corporation]Zoo’s games[/url].

notes.title: Updated [ver1.1.0]
notes.notes:
For those interested in playing the Japanese version of Princess Kaguya, we've now added Japanese language support to Steam.
If you'd like a language other than English or Japanese please let us know.  
Japanese language support is the only change in this update.
